metadata.title: Research data supporting PACo-Aptamer: ligand-conditioned inverse folding for RNA aptamer design
metadata.description:
Curated research data supporting the PACo-Aptamer manuscript. The archive contains the final cluster-, time- and ligand-holdout splits; 6,346 canonical cleaned RNA chain structures; RNA–ligand complex features; preprocessed training data for PACo-Aptamer and the four retrained baselines; final benchmark and analysis outputs; designed-sequence pools; Extended Data and Supplementary tables; predicted-backbone and aptamer–target interaction assets; and the selected final PACo-Aptamer, RhoDesign, gRNAde, NA-MPNN and AlignIF checkpoints. Paths mirror the source repository. A per-file SHA-256 manifest is included.

The bulk raw RCSB PDB/mmCIF download, intermediate caches, logs, superseded backups, third-party Python libraries and development checkpoints are excluded. External software and upstream structure-prediction weights remain necessary for full retraining and refolding workflows.

Source code: RNA_tertiary_stru_IF (MIT). This dataset is released under CC BY 4.0. Primary data originate from the RCSB Protein Data Bank, PDB Chemical Component Dictionary, AptaDB and the UTexas Aptamer Database; see the archive README for attribution and scope.
